🔥 claude-swarm | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Orchestrating parallel AI coding agents for complex, long-running autonomous development tasks with built-in safety and monitoring.
✨ Key Features: • Persistent State Management • Parallel Claude Code Workers via tmux • Git Worktree Isolation • Worker Plan Mode with Competitive Planning • Confidence Monitoring and Enforced Verification
📖 Summary: Claude Swarm is a TypeScript-based MCP server designed to orchestrate parallel Claude Code worker swarms for long-running autonomous coding sessions. It features persistent state management, Git worktree isolation, and protocol-based behavioral governance to ensure reliable and constrained AI-driven development.
